title: senecio fluviatilis subsp. fuchsii
intro: Senecio fluviatilis subsp. fuchsii, commonly known as River Dusty Miller, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Therapeutically, it is believed to have actions such as lowering fever, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
